messages.content: I forgot my password and cannot sign in anymore. How do I reset it?

Open the sign-in page and select “Forgot password”. We will email you a reset link; open that link within 30 minutes and type a new password of at least 12 characters. After that, sign in again on all your devices, because changing the password signs out every session.

Which organelle is known as the powerhouse of the cell, and what does it produce?
The mitochondria is known as the powerhouse of the cell. It produces most of the chemical energy, stored as ATP, that powers the cell's biochemical reactions.
How do I change the email address on my account?
Open your profile settings and choose “Account email”. Enter the new address and confirm it by opening the verification link we send you; the old address stays active until you confirm.
